author: News Advocate Staff
title: Munson's Mary Free Bed ranked among state's best rehab programs - NewsBreak
text:
By News Advocate Staff ,
12 hours ago U.S. News & World Report recently ranked Mary Free Bed at Munson Healthcare No. 4 in Michigan among inpatient rehabilitation facilities. (Oleg Breslavtsev/Getty Images) Helping patients recover, regain independence and return to the activities they love has earned Mary Free Bed at Munson Healthcare statewide recognition. U.S. News & World Report recently ranked the program No. 4 in Michigan among inpatient rehabilitation facilities, recognizing its strong patient outcomes and high-quality care.
The 25-bed inpatient rehabilitation program at Munson Medical Center cared for nearly 650 patients over the past year, providing specialized treatment for individuals recovering from stroke, traumatic brain injury, spinal cord injury, neurological conditions, complex orthopedic injuries, amputations and other life-altering illnesses and injuries.
"This recognition reflects the dedication and expertise of our entire rehabilitation team," Jill Slagal, executive director of rehabilitation services, said. "Every day, our therapists, physicians, nurses and support staff work together to help patients achieve meaningful recovery and restore freedom."
Through its partnership with Mary Free Bed Rehabilitation, Munson Healthcare provides nationally recognized rehabilitation expertise to patients throughout northern Michigan, allowing them to receive advanced care close to home and their support systems.
"We're proud to provide nationally recognized rehabilitation care close to home," Dr. Tom Schermerhorn, chief medical officer of Munson Medical Center, said. "The Mary Free Bed at Munson Team helps patients rebuild their lives after serious injury or illness, allowing them to recover near the people and communities that support them."
The recognition highlights Mary Free Bed and Munson Healthcare's continued commitment to clinical excellence and expanding access to advanced rehabilitation services across Northern Michigan.
